integrity_statement: All formulas and example verifications refer to this theorem only. Exact rational tests support but do not replace its proof; literature priority remains subject to external verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite deterministic synchronous two-layer DeGroot updates only; first layer loopless uniform complete, second layer connected nonbipartite undirected positively weighted graph with minimum support-degree at least two. The canonical opinion witness is inverse weighted degree, not every opinion. No independent historical-priority validation or stochastic-network extrapolation.
title: Universal odd–even overshoot of influence under complete-layer switching
